subject: Re: SolarWave onboarding — request for combined credit + discount approval
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@solarwave.co>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2028-03-15 09:12 PDT
Subject: Onboarding terms — request for blended credits + discount

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about Redwood’s latency profile for embeddings. Procurement asked me to surface two asks before we can sign: a one-time onboarding credit to cover our initial evaluation spend (~$25k) and a 12% first-year volume discount in the contract. We know those are outside the standard playbook, but SolarWave has a tight Q2 deployment window and this helps us get to production faster.

I attached our standard PO template and proof of funds. Can you advise on who we need to loop in for an exception? Happy to hop on a quick call.

Thanks,
Lydia Park
Head of Procurement | SolarWave Energy
[Attachment: SWQ-PO-Proof.pdf (pdf)]

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com, grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia.park@solarwave.co>
Date: 2028-03-15 10:05 PDT
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding terms — request for blended credits + discount

Marissa / Grace — looping you both for a quick approval path. SolarWave is a strategic renewables platform (pilot -> production fast). They’re asking for a $25k one-time onboarding credit + 12% first-year volume discount. HubSpot deal attached: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-9843.

Metrics: committed ARR potential $320k, 12 month ramp expected; pilot spend estimate $45k in Q2. They’re already short-listing Redwood for a regionally sensitive deployment (US west). Procurement sent PO & proof — attached.

If we can’t do full 12% + $25k credit, a counter I’d propose is: $15k onboarding credit + 8% first-year discount + 3-month extension on trial credits (additional $10k buffer) to bridge ramp. That keeps unit economics intact while buying the deal.

Can you advise approval and signoff cadence? Lydia is ready to sign quickly if we move.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
--
Original message attached below for context.

From: marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com, grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2028-03-15 11:40 PDT
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding terms — request for blended credits + discount

Rishi — thanks for the write-up. Given the ARR profile and strategic west-coast presence, I’m comfortable approving an exception but want to formalize limits. Approve up to: $20k one-time onboarding credit + up to 10% first-year discount, contingent on a 12-month minimum term and a defined churn/license fallback clause in the MSA. Require Sales to include an active ROI metric (expected token/unit consumption, predicted monthly spend) in the contract exhibit.

Grace — can you confirm finance OK with the $20k/$320k math and add simple guardrails (cap on monthly credits, lookback clause)? If yes, I’ll route to Legal for an expedited MSA amendment and signatory approval.

Marissa Cole
SVP, Sales | Redwood Inference

From: grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2028-03-15 14:02 PDT
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding terms — request for blended credits + discount

Marissa / Rishi — finance greenlighted the ask with the conditions below: 1) $20k onboarding credit applied over first 90 days (monthly amortization cap $8k); 2) 10% first-year discount applied to committed usage only; 3) an overage protection clause (we can pause credits if utilization is >150% of forecast without prior approval). Also need an exhibit with projected token volumes and a go-live milestone for credits to start.

I’ll prepare a short approval note for Legal and Billing to attach to the contract.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@solarwave.co>, Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@solarwave.co>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com, grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2028-03-15 15:18 PDT
Subject: Re: Onboarding terms — request for blended credits + discount

Lydia / Ethan — great news: we can do the following as an approved one-time exception: 1) $20k onboarding credit (applied over first 90 days, monthly cap $8k); 2) 10% first-year discount on committed usage; 3) credits activate once go-live milestone is met and MSA amendment signed. Finance and Marissa signed off pending the exhibit with token projections.

I’ve attached our standard MSA mark-up and the DocuSign room link; if you can confirm the go-live milestone (estimated by you as Aug 1, 2028) and accept the exhibit requirements, Legal will fast-track the amendment.

Links/attachments: SolarWave_MSA_v2.pdf, DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/rooms/abc123-solarwave-onramp

Next steps: 1) SolarWave confirms milestone + signs amendment; 2) Redwood billing issues credit schedule; 3) credits begin once milestone validated.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SolarWave_MSA_v2.pdf (pdf)]
